g.text: • Benefit Management System Heuristic Review — Component Audit
• Base configuration for on-site mobile fittings
• Defines destination tax code and reporting entity
• Primary POC assignment for notification trigger
• Trip date bypass: POS calculates date at scan
• Cross-reference roster eligibility prior to checkout
• Two-factor WHO validation for multi-site staff
• Department override takes precedence over plant
• Unused subsidy balance rolls forward or expires
• Employee co-pay applied if total cart > subsidy
• Two distribution endpoints configured per order
• Direct ship to home allowed for remote workers
• Aggregated packing slips generated for plant docks
Step 1: Heuristic Review & Architecture Audit — Whiteboard Component Mapping (Main, Required, Subsidy, Send)
